WASHOE COUNTY
                         Integrity    Communication     Service
                                www.washoecounty.gov




                                     STAFF REPORT
                      BOARD MEETING DATE: October 13, 2026


       DATE: Thursday, October 01, 2026
          TO: Board of County Commissioners
      FROM: Mark Stewart, Purchasing and Contracts Manager
            (775) 328-2281, mstewart@washoecounty.gov

 THROUGH: Cathy Hill, Comptroller, chill@washoecounty.gov

  SUBJECT: Information and acknowledgement of receipt by the Board of County
           Commissioners of contracts and purchases that have exceeded or are
           expected to exceed [$300,000] that may include services and supplies
           for all County departments. Pursuant to Washoe County Code 15.490,
           the purchasing and contracts manager is authorized, subject to the
           provisions of Washoe County Code and the applicable provision of state
           law, to approve purchases and contracts up to [$300,000]. As a matter
           of best practices, the purchasing and contracts manager will keep the
           Board of County Commissioners informed of all contracts and purchases
           for all county departments that have been previously approved that have
           exceeded or are expected to exceed the threshold amount. A full list of
           specific contracts, vendors, and amounts is viewable in the staff report.
           The aggregate amount of known expenditures under these contracts to
           date is $7,594,863.72. Comptroller. (All Commission Districts.) FOR
           POSSIBLE ACTION

SUMMARY
The purpose of this item is to inform the Board that these County services are
anticipated to reach or exceed expenditures in the aggregate of $300,000, which
is the reporting threshold.
Washoe County Strategic Objective supported by this item: Stewardship of our
Community
RECENT PREVIOUS ACTION
June 23, 2026, The Washoe County Board of Commissioners approved the necessary
purchases that exceeded or were expected to exceed $300,000

April 14, 2026, The Washoe County Board of Commissioners approved the necessary
purchases that exceeded or were expected to exceed $300,000

February 10, 2026, The Washoe County Board of Commissioners approved the necessary
purchases that exceeded or were expected to exceed $300,000


                                                        AGENDA ITEM # ______

Washoe County Commission Meeting of October 13, 2026
                                                                                Page 2 of 3


October 21, 2025, The Washoe County Board of Commissioners approved the necessary
purchases that exceeded or were expected to exceed $300,000

June 24, 2025, The Washoe County Board of Commissioners approved the necessary
purchases that exceeded or were expected to exceed $300,000

April 8, 2025, The Washoe County Board of Commissioners approved the necessary
purchases that exceeded or were expected to exceed $300,000


BACKGROUND
Washoe County Code 15.490 requires that purchases of supplies, materials,
equipment and contractual services required by the agencies in annual amount
or estimated annual amounts in excess of $300,000 must be submitted to the
Board of County Commissioners for approval.

Washoe County vendors that have or are estimated to exceed this threshold and
the goods or services that were supplied are listed below:

Marathon Staffing Group Inc. - $1,223,452.09 – Countywide Temporary
Staffing Services

Dell Marketing LP - $1,154,664 – 2026 Technology Refresh

EPlus Technology Inc - $1,096,717.45 – Various IT and Software products
(primarily Tech Services)

Manpower Temporary Services - $757,778.37 – Countywide Temporary
Staffing Services

Canon Financial Services Inc. - $623,477.79 – Countywide Copiers

Brady Industries of Nevada LLC - $606,229.20 – Janitorial and Facilities
Services – Countywide

SHI International Corp - $536,544.78 – Various IT and Software
(primarily Tech Services)

Thomson Reuters – West - $3,75,646.66 – Legal subscription services for
Courts, DA, etc.

Johnson Controls Fire Protection LP - $340,355.69 – Fire
Alarm/Suppression services for County buildings

Kone Inc. - $329,432.09 – Elevator Services Countywide

Purcell Tire & Rubber - $300,565.60 – Tires for County vehicles – CSD

Washoe County Commission Meeting of October 13, 2026
                                                                                  Page 3 of 3


22nd Century Technologies Inc - $250,000 – Temporary Workers for
Registrar of Voters

FISCAL IMPACT
These expenses have been recognized in the appropriate cost objects for material
and service purchases under NRS 332 and do not include public works projects
that fall under NRS 338. There is no additional fiscal impact associated with this
staff report.

RECOMMENDATION
Recommendation to acknowledge receipt by the Board of County Commissioners
of contracts and purchases that have exceeded or are expected to exceed
[$300,000] that may include services and supplies for all County departments.
Pursuant to Washoe County Code 15.490, the purchasing and contracts manager
is authorized, subject to the provisions of Washoe County Code and the
applicable provision of state law, to approve purchases and contracts up to
[$300,000]. As a matter of best practices, the purchasing and contracts manager
will keep the Board of County Commissioners informed of all contracts and
purchases for all county departments that have been previously approved that
have exceeded or are expected to exceed the threshold amount. A full list of
specific contracts, vendors, and amounts is viewable in the staff report. The
aggregate amount of known expenditures under these contracts to date is
$7,594,863.72.

POSSIBLE MOTION
Should the Board agree with the staff’s recommendation, a possible motion
would be to: acknowledge receipt by the Board of County Commissioners of
contracts and purchases that have exceeded or are expected to exceed
[$300,000] that may include services and supplies for all County departments.
Pursuant to Washoe County Code 15.490, the purchasing and contracts manager
is authorized, subject to the provisions of Washoe County Code and the
applicable provision of state law, to approve purchases and contracts up to
[$300,000]. As a matter of best practices, the purchasing and contracts manager
will keep the Board of County Commissioners informed of all contracts and
purchases for all county departments that have been previously approved that
have exceeded or are expected to exceed the threshold amount. A full list of
specific contracts, vendors, and amounts is viewable in the staff report. The
aggregate amount of known expenditures under these contracts to date is
$7,594,863.72.
